request: If a reduced rational number h/q is a root of multiplicity t of a nonzero integer polynomial then q^t is at most its absolute leading coefficient.

items.name: Polynomial.rootMultiplicity
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → R → Polynomial R → ℕ

items.name: den_dvd_of_is_root
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
  [inst_3 : Field K] [inst_4 : Algebra A K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing A K] {p : Polynomial A} {r : K},
  (Polynomial.aeval r) p = 0 → ↑(IsFractionRing.den A r) ∣ p.leadingCoeff

items.name: num_dvd_of_is_root
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsDomain A] [inst_2 : UniqueFactorizationMonoid A]
  [inst_3 : Field K] [inst_4 : Algebra A K] [inst_5 : IsFractionRing A K] {p : Polynomial A} {r : K},
  (Polynomial.aeval r) p = 0 → IsFractionRing.num A r ∣ p.coeff 0

items.name: Polynomial.card_roots
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → ↑p.roots.card ≤ p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_le_rootMultiplicity_of_dvd
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {p q : Polynomial R},
  q ≠ 0 → p ∣ q → ∀ (x : R), Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x p ≤ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x q

items.name: Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_le_one_of_separable
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.Separable → ∀ (x : R), Polynomial.rootMultiplicity x p ≤ 1
